title: Scaffold the Vue 3 + TS component library
description: Stand up the package skeleton: Vue 3 + TypeScript with Vite in library build mode, configured so the component can be installed from the personal GitHub repo into other Vue projects. Establish the public entry point, build output (ESM), generated type declarations, and a minimal test + lint setup. No Sanity or AI wiring yet — just a clean, installable, typed shell that exports a placeholder component.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` produces an ESM bundle plus a `.d.ts` type declaration via a Vite library-mode config.
package.json declares correct `exports`, `types`, `peerDependencies` (vue), and `files`, and is installable via a GitHub URL.
A placeholder component is exported from the package entry and can be imported and mounted in a throwaway consumer.
Unit test runner and linter run green via the project's default commands.
